experiment: Answer-bearing pair coverage audit of Stage264
method: Use the benchmark's chronological session sort and pair-turn construction, answer_session_ids, and has_answer annotations to compare gold answer-bearing source-session/pair IDs with Stage264 retrieved source metadata. This is a read-only diagnostic; annotations are not used at runtime.
decision: Keep Top-200 pair recall as a separate retrieval diagnostic. It adds five answer-marked pairs and five complete-pair questions over Top-20, while 58 of the 65 wrong answerable rows already contain every answer-marked pair in Top-20. Prioritize evidence synthesis, temporal anchoring, and answer validation for further gains; broader retrieval alone cannot account for most remaining errors.
precision_boundary: Answer-bearing pair recall is not factual precision. The 100% memory-precision target remains unmeasured.
